steps.code:
# Create the "Price Range" feature
df['Price Range'] = df['High'] - df['Low']

# Display some statistics about the new feature
print("First few rows with Price Range:")
print(df[['High', 'Low', 'Price Range']].head(10))

# Calculate statistics
price_range_mean = df['Price Range'].mean()
# Using population standard deviation formula (ddof=0)
price_range_stddev = df['Price Range'].std(ddof=0)

print(f"\nPrice Range Mean: {price_range_mean}")
print(f"Price Range Std Dev (population): {price_range_stddev}")

# Perform Shapiro-Wilk test for normality
statistic, p_value = stats.shapiro(df['Price Range'])

print(f"Shapiro-Wilk Test Statistic: {statistic}")
print(f"P-value: {p_value}")

# Determine if data follows normal distribution (p-value > 0.05)
is_normal = "yes" if p_value > 0.05 else "no"
print(f"Is Normal (p-value > 0.05)?: {is_normal}")

# Round to the required decimal places
price_range_mean_rounded = round(price_range_mean, 2)
price_range_stddev_rounded = round(price_range_stddev, 2)
p_value_rounded = round(p_value, 4)

print(f"\nRounded values:")
print(f"Mean: {price_range_mean_rounded}")
print(f"Std Dev: {price_range_stddev_rounded}")
print(f"P-value: {p_value_rounded}")
print(f"Is Normal: {is_normal}")
